before_new_task.description: Auto-create GitButler virtual branch for new tasks

after_task_complete.description: Auto-commit to GitButler virtual branch with V12 message format

after_edit.description: Auto-assign edited files to current virtual branch (experimental)

after_subagent_batch.description: V2.8: Deterministic MCP compliance audit after every wave-7 batch. Reads WAVE7_BATCH_PHASE + WAVE7_BATCH_EPICS env vars. Exit 0=all pass, Exit 1=failures (redo list at /tmp/wave7_redo.txt), Exit 2=hook error.

env_vars.WAVE7_BATCH_EPICS: Space-separated EPIC-W7-NNN IDs in the completed batch

output_files./tmp/wave7_redo.txt: Failed epic IDs, one per line — read by orchestrator redo loop
output_files./tmp/wave7_audit_result.json: Full JSON audit result for this batch

exit_codes.0: ALL_PASS — orchestrator may proceed to next batch
exit_codes.1: HAS_FAILURES — orchestrator reads /tmp/wave7_redo.txt and re-spawns those epics
exit_codes.2: HOOK_ERROR — missing args or script not found; escalate to Director
